purpose: M1.g3 ordinary main-session context suggestion and settlement acceptance
requirement: 在独立克隆中阅读上下文生命周期相关代码与文档，解释建议的决策、采纳与结算路径，指出可验证的局限；通过自然追问继续这一真实调查。
scope: 只读代码和文档；不修改源文件，不执行交付或合并
nonGoals: 不注入事件、修改存储或改变用户全局配置；不以结果证明实际压缩或真实节省
provider: AIDER candidate; select and freeze actual provider and model before dispatch
model: pending selection and account readiness; no request before separate preregistration
settings: suggest; debug provider off; normal project trust; no demo
evidence: external UI observation and SQLite consistent read-only backup
stopConditions: missing permissions, no usable model, no natural suggestion, unknown cost, failure or unmet normal UI control: record and stop; no fabricated data; same-cause failure max two
appDataIsolation: Tauri ephemeral WebView and separate app data; CLI HOME remains shared
status: preparation only, model and environment must be frozen before any model request
